text:
emily.ae: Heads-up — HelixCorp procurement paused their POC until we provide a signed data-residency attestation + a firm pilot spend cap. They want CTO/CISO call before PO release. Can Sec/Eng join a quick sync today?

raj.presales: I can join. Do we have a short attestation template Legal prefers or should Sec draft a one-pager? Also is the spend cap weekly or total for the 30-day trial?

tara.sec: We have a standard one-pager we can adapt: region guarantee, no raw-data egress without approval, 90-day audit log retention. Need to confirm KMS (BYOK vs Redwood) and whether they require HSM attestation.

david.eng: We can provision a Dedicated VPC pilot in ~72h. On-prem would add weeks. If they require model pinning/quantization, we should run a quick compatibility test against their samples.

rachel.csm: Procurement insists on a hard cap for the pilot. Finance must approve any figure. I can help get exec sponsor if we get the signed attestation.

raj.presales: Draft pricing to present: 30-day Dedicated pilot, optional BYOK, pilot cap $4,500 total or $0.00085/token overage (customer-favoring). Can Finance confirm?

tara.sec: OK to present. Draft attestation for Legal review:

"Data Residency Attestation (draft) - Customer data processed only in region: eu-west-2. - No export of raw data outside region without customer approval. - Customer may elect BYOK or Redwood KMS with HSM. - Inference request audit logs retained 90 days."

emily.ae: @sd-bot please open an internal ticket to track approvals and owners.

sd-bot: Created ticket SD-7210 (Helix POC BoardHold). Assigned: raj.presales, tara.sec, legal-team.

david.eng: Reserving a staging slot. If BYOK, start KMS onboarding paperwork (24-48h). Recommend a 1-hour validation once sanitized samples are uploaded.

rachel.csm: Uploading sanitized samples to secure share and inviting Eng/Sec now.

raj.presales: If Finance signs off, plan: 1) Send draft attestation + pricing to customer today, 2) schedule 30m CTO/CISO call tomorrow with our execs, 3) run compatibility test once samples are in. Target: PO released by Fri EOD.

tara.sec: Legal wants addendum: "Redwood will provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48 hours of request." Getting legal eyes.

emily.ae: Thanks all — I'll push to Legal and post back when signed. If Legal stalls we may need an exec intro earlier.
